pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.AllyCopy: Copper charged when one party member copies a formula from another.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.AutoClai: Collect deliveries and payments for your characters automatically. When off, you are told when something is waiting.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.ComplexC: Use the Complex Crafting variant for setup times.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.CostOfLi: Deduct cost of living from downtime income.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.CountHel: Let Communal Crafting helpers count even when the crafter lacks the feat.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.CrafterS: Handing an order to a new crafter starts its setup and check again.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.Downtime: What happens when a downtime check uses a reroll or an activated bonus.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.EarnInco: Extra DC for Earn Income with skills other than Crafting, Performance and Lore.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.EasyDcFo: Lower the DC for an item the crafter has made before.
Turns the Artisan's Workshop on for this world. Turning it on creates the shared ledger and strongbox that every player can use.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.FamilyCo: A formula for one grade of an item also covers its lower grades.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.FormulaS: Percent added to the price of rare formulas.
Percent added to the price of uncommon formulas.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.HelperCa: Most Communal Crafting helpers per order; 0 means no limit.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.HelperCr: A helper's critical success counts one level higher.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.HelperFa: A helper's failure still contributes a little.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.HelperLe: A helper who leaves before the order ends loses everything they contributed.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.Inventor: Allow inventing formulas for uncommon and rare items.
Days of setup for inventing a formula.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.Legendar: Item level from which crafting needs legendary proficiency.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.Precious: Allow coins to stand in for the precious material share of common items.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.Purge.Hi: Remove everything the Artisan's Workshop has stored in this world. You confirm before anything is removed.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.Recomput: A crafter who levels up mid-order earns the new daily rate.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.SetupInt: Setup days already worked are kept when an order is paused.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.SnareToo: Snares are crafted with an artisan's toolkit.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Settings.Uncommon: Uncommon and rarer items need their formula, not only access.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Sync.Duplicate: A second copy of the Workshop's shared data ({name}) exists. The oldest copy is in use; move anything you need from {name} and delete it.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Sync.Newer: Artisan's Workshop data was saved by a newer version of the module. It is read-only here until this module is updated.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Sync.OwnershipRep: {name} was given back to every player as Owner, so the Artisan's Workshop can use it.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Sync.PendingRows: {count} of your Workshop ledger entries did not finish. Details are in the console; a GM can settle them.
pf2e-artisans-workshop.Sync.Stale: The Artisan's Workshop data in this window may be out of date after a conflicting change. Reload to continue.
